title: Run MASH using iMicrobe
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s9ueh6w

steps.title: Select Mock Communities
steps.instruction: Acquire mock communities (artificially generated 454 reads, 10 million reads per file, created using GemSim from known composition profiles) via the iMicrobe sample search page and add them to the cart.

steps.title: Launch MASH App
steps.instruction: Navigate to the 'tools' dropdown menu, select 'Apps', and click on 'mash-all-vs-all-0.0.5u1'.

steps.title: Configure and Run MASH
steps.instruction: Provide the input files from the cart and set the application parameters.

steps.title: Access Job Results
steps.instruction: Once the job has run, retrieve the outputs from the CyVerse datastore.

substeps.instruction: Go to the 'Tools' dropdown menu and select 'Jobs'.
Select the job corresponding to the run and navigate to the 'Outputs' section.
Click 'Browse and view output files in the CyVerse Datastore'.

steps.title: Retrieve Output Files
steps.instruction: Navigate to the 'mash-out' folder within the job folder in the CyVerse datastore to find the results.

substeps.instruction: Locate the 'sketches' folder containing the mash sketches index files (*.msh extension).

Locate the 'figures' folder containing the final outputs: distance.txt (tabular all-versus-all distance matrix), dendrogram.png (hclust R function, ward clustering), dendrogram_fan.png (Fan dendrogram of a Newick tree), heatmap.png (distance matrix heatmap, scale 0 white to 1 dark blue), pcoa.pdf (PCOA), and tree.newick (Newick tree).
